- [statement] Schreiber and Schmitz explain that rejection of a stationary linear surrogate null can be caused by nonlinearity or nonstationarity, and that nonlinearity alone does not establish deterministic chaos. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/chao-dyn/9909037 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
- [statement] Ruiz-Ortiz et al. write each point-cloud window as Z^t={z_t,...,z_(t+w-1)}, so a forward implementation must timestamp that window only after its last observation is available. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2203.05603 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
